_que_es: Armador, hoja F (2026-11-02): los del núcleo y la tienda que no tenían imagen. Base: node tools/render3d/icons.cjs render check spin codes luck money_boost friends search notifications egg_gold --out <carpeta>; después como la hoja E.

ia.prompt: Keep the same 9 objects, in this order: 1) check: a glossy green rounded square button with a big white check mark, 2) spin: a prize wheel with eight bright colored slices (pink, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, purple, red), a golden rim, a golden center pin and a red pointer on top, on a small wooden stand, 3) codes: a purple ticket with notched edges and a golden star in the middle, 4) luck: a bright green four-leaf clover with heart-shaped leaves and a short curved stem, 5) money_boost: a fat golden money bag tied with a brown string, with a green dollar sign on the front, 6) friends: two smiling round friend heads side by side, one blue and one green, with simple happy faces, 7) search: a golden magnifying glass with a light blue glass lens and a brown wooden handle, 8) notifications: a golden bell with a little red dot on its top right, 9) egg_gold: a shiny solid gold egg with bright metallic highlights.
